Microsoft 365 includes familiar apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, and OneDrive, plus Copilot experiences that help you create, find, summarize, and get things done across your work. Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat brings together work context through natural conversation, helping you understand priorities, catch up on progress, clarify intent, explore options, and identify next steps without breaking your flow.

Microsoft Copilot brings personal and work experiences into one simpler place while keeping them separate. Work stays work, and personal stays personal, so your work data, chats, files, and organizational protections remain separate from your personal Copilot experience.

Copilot is built with security, privacy, and compliance in mind. It respects existing permissions and enterprise protections, helping safeguard your content, accounts, and collaboration while you work.

Copilot responds when you choose to use it. You stay in control of when and how you use AI features, and your existing privacy and security settings continue to apply.

headings.text: Work smarter across Microsoft 365 with Copilot
AI tools to search, chat, create, and stay in the flow
01/ Microsoft 365 brings your favorite apps together with Copilot
02/ Copilot helps you quickly get oriented and move work forward
03/ Microsoft Copilot keeps work and personal experiences separate
04/ Copilot works with Microsoft 365 security protections
05/ You're in control of when you use AI

jsonld_parsed.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot is your AI-first productivity assistant, helping you chat, search, create, and collaborate with your favorite Microsoft 365 apps including Microsoft Word, Excel and PowerPoint.

internal_links.text: Improve my writing Rewrite this text to make it more professional and less verbose. Try this prompt
Create an image Design an image of a drawing of a database in colored pencil. Try this prompt
Understand what is changed List recent activity in /file Try this prompt
Visualize my data Create a bar chart of [energy consumption for the top 5 energy consuming countries]. Try this prompt
Interview prep Create a set of interview questions for the position of [Software Engineer]. Try this prompt
Find my calm What are some ways to reduce stress? Try this prompt
Get started with chat Think through projects, summarize information, and keep work moving forward in one conversation. Go to Chat
Find what you need Get grounded answers and quickly find the information, files, and insights you need to get work done. Go to Search
Access your apps Type /apps to open Microsoft 365 apps like Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and more. Open Apps

external_links.text: Word with Copilot Draft smarter and finish faster. Open Word
Excel with Copilot Unlock insights and make informed decisions. Open Excel
PowerPoint with Copilot Turn ideas into polished presentations. Open PowerPoint
Outlook with Copilot Move work forward with email and calendar. Open Outlook

Why use image generation in Copilot?

Start with prompt templates

The Create section includes ready-to-use prompts that make it easy to explore text to image generation—even if you're new to it. Just describe your idea and let Copilot do the rest.

Go to Create module

Chat your way to better visuals

Use Copilot in chat to iterate on your image—refine the style, adjust the composition, or explore variations. It's a dynamic way to co-create with an AI image generator.

Open Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat

Enjoy high-quality results

Copilot uses the latest models to deliver sharper, more accurate images—so your visuals look polished and professional, right from the start.

Try image generation

3 tips for getting high impact AI images

Tip #1: Detail your vision

The more specific you are with your description, the better the AI can capture your vision. Think about the mood, colors, themes, and any key elements like art style or poster inspiration that you want in your image.

Tip #2: Consider composition

Enhance your storytelling with framing choices like camera angle, subject placement, and visual hierarchy. These cues help shape the mood, whether you want a cinematic moment or a clean minimal layout.

Tip #3: Refine and experiment

If your initial output isn't what you'd envisioned, adjust and re-prompt. Experiment with variations in your description—altering themes, style, or specific elements can help refine your image.

Slide preview Design a bold presentation slide with a purple background, the title 'About' in large display text, and a real person included in the layout. Try this prompt Workplace scene Envision a workplace scene of a modern office environment with collaborative workspaces, digital whiteboards, and natural lighting. Try this prompt Moodboard visual Make a soft-focus, pastel-toned moodboard with textures, typography samples, and lifestyle imagery for a wellness brand. Try this prompt Product photo Create a sneaker product photo, white base with pastel accents, clean background with soft blue shapes. Go to Create module Chat your way to better visuals Use Copilot in chat to iterate on your image—refine the style, adjust the composition, or explore variations. Open Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat Enjoy high-quality results Copilot uses the latest models to deliver sharper, more accurate images—so your visuals look polished and professional, right from the start. Try image generation 3 tips for getting high impact AI images Tip #1: Detail your vision The more specific you are with your description, the better the AI can capture your vision. Think about the mood, colors, themes, and any key elements like art style or poster inspiration that you want in your image. Tip #2: Consider composition Enhance your storytelling with framing choices like camera angle, subject placement, and visual hierarchy. These cues help shape the mood, whether you want a cinematic moment or a clean minimal layout. Tip #3: Refine and experiment If your initial output isn't what you'd envisioned, adjust and re-prompt. https://m365.cloud.microsoft/ai-image-ge.meta_description: Generate images with AI using Microsoft 365 Copilot AI image generator. Turn your ideas into visuals with text-to-image generation.

headings.text: Why use image generation in Copilot?
Chat your way to better visuals
3 tips for getting high impact AI images

internal_links.text: Slide preview Design a bold presentation slide with a purple background, the title 'About' in large display text, and a real person included in the layout. Try this prompt

User journey map Create a stylized flowchart illustrating five stages of a customer journey or marketing funnel, connected by a wavy line with nodes at each stage with minimal icons and annotations. Try this prompt
Workplace scene Envision a workplace scene of a modern office environment with collaborative workspaces, digital whiteboards, and natural lighting. Try this prompt
Moodboard visual Make a soft-focus, pastel-toned moodboard with textures, typography samples, and lifestyle imagery for a wellness brand. Try this prompt
Product photo Create a sneaker product photo, white base with pastel accents, clean background with soft blue shapes. Try this prompt

Infographic Minimal 4-step flowchart: Assess (blue, magnifying glass), Plan (green, light bulb), Implement (orange, gear), Optimize (brown, graph). Flat icons, clean arrows, no embellishments. Try this prompt

Template Create a minimal business stationery mockup with a white letterhead, colorful geometric header (red, yellow, purple), and bold red 'NP' logo with contact info at bottom left. Displayed on beige textured blocks over a light blue background. Try this prompt
Presentation slide Design a minimal presentation title slide with beige background, text 'brand launch strategy', with subtle abstract flower shapes. Try this prompt
Event poster Design a retro open house poster, pink background, bold title, pink and orange colors, and abstract colorful shapes. Try this prompt
Visual Create an image of a hand-sketched style bar graph graphic visually demonstrating growth without any text. Try this prompt
Wallpaper Create a calm landscape wallpaper with a serene lake, green hills, clear sky, colorful wildflowers, and smooth rocks by the water. Try this prompt
Illustration Create a colorful presentation illustration that represents people at work. Try this prompt
